summary: Extend the accepted predecessor with an additive, default-off runnable lane that builds and smokes the adjacent fork launcher/core pair using dev-small, a short per-worktree target, incremental compilation on, and sccache off. Warm changed-core build-through-version was 92.963-98.635 seconds. Incremental-on cold build-through-version was 648.476 seconds, so the result does not support a universal ten-minute claim.

taskDisposition.reason: The predecessor solves correctness verification only. Runnable launcher behavior, exact artifact freshness, runtime dependencies, storage, concurrency, and cleanup require a separate contract.

contractSeparation.runnableSmoke: Exact changed launcher/core version, authenticated no-tool, and benign shell-tool passes.
contractSeparation.debugDevPerformance: dev-small is opt-level 0, no debug symbols, stripped symbols, no LTO; behavior iteration only.
contractSeparation.publishFidelity: Existing thin-LTO release and vendor packaging remain unchanged.

measurements.driverProvenance: Every run records the PowerShell executable/version, process command line/argv, effective driver argv, culture, UI culture, and timezone.

smokeAcceptance.requirements: No-tool JSONL has exactly four whitelisted events and no tool/error item. Tool JSONL has exactly six whitelisted events, one normalized pwsh Write-Output FAST_TOOL_OK command start/completion, exact FAST_TOOL_OK output, and exact final message. Timeout termination is bounded and verified for captured process-tree PIDs only.
smokeAcceptance.timeoutPreflight: A one-second forced-timeout run verified tree/root termination for all three probes and left zero target processes.

attribution.sccacheCausality: provisional; all measured arms disabled sccache
attribution.coldTimingCausality: provisional; serial ordering and one sample confound the cold comparison

alternatives.name: Extend predecessor with runnable tier
alternatives.reason: Lowest conflict; reuses accepted dispatch, locking, provenance, probe, reconciliation, tests, and docs.

alternatives.name: New Cargo profile
alternatives.reason: Existing dev-small passes the warm SLO; no evidence justifies upstream-canonical profile conflict.

alternatives.name: Incremental off default
alternatives.reason: Saves 5.184-7.286 GiB but makes the measured private edit 101.995 seconds slower.

alternatives.name: Global shared target or mixed sccache/incremental
alternatives.reason: Concurrency/provenance risk and unmeasured sccache causality.

alternatives.name: Release/LTO or crate-boundary changes
alternatives.reason: Unnecessary for a warm lane measured at 92.963-98.635 seconds through launch.

safetyAndConflictSurface: Derive a short per-worktree target; do not mutate one global target across worktrees.
Use exclusive ownership/locking and record repository, dirty state, profile, bins, toolchain, environment, timestamps, and hashes.
Fail closed on failed or interrupted builds; do not smoke or bless prior artifacts.
Detect running target executables by exact path/PID; never kill by process name.
Guard cleanup with the owner manifest and never delete release targets, arbitrary paths, or installed binaries.
Keep the first implementation in fork wrapper scripts/tests/docs; avoid patched-Codex Rust and Cargo.toml changes.
Keep release profile, publish command, vendor layout, helper packaging, and optimized smoke unchanged.
testStrategy: Deterministic target derivation and unsafe/deep/shared path rejection.
Environment clearing, fixed profile/bin selection, and sccache policy tests.
Target owner lock plus stale, dirty, changed-HEAD, and interrupted manifest tests.
Exact-path version, authenticated, and benign shell-tool smokes with CODEX_CORE_PATH unset.
Retain predecessor T1/T2 and an optimized publish smoke outside the lane.
rollback: Remove additive runnable dispatch, tests, measurement integration, and docs, then delete only owner-verified fast targets. Existing verification tiers, release profile, publish command, release targets, and installed binaries remain untouched.

planSeed.goal: Implement an additive, explicit, default-off runnable Codex development lane using the measured dev-small incremental arm while preserving all correctness and release gates.
planSeed.prerequisite: Branch from or rebase onto accepted predecessor HEAD 2a95dd19c89fc99492d0e5a25d77cb070fe77da3. Extend its verifier rather than creating a parallel command.
stories: Add runnable dispatch that builds codex-cli/codex-core plus codex-copilot-launcher/codex with dev-small, a short per-worktree target, incremental on, sccache off, and conflicting overrides cleared.
Add exclusive ownership/locking, provenance/freshness manifests, interrupted-build fail-closed behavior, exact-path process detection, and guarded cleanup.
Add exact-path version, authenticated no-tool, and benign shell-tool smokes with CODEX_CORE_PATH unset; report helper/package gaps without weakening publish.
Extend predecessor measurement/tests with exact command/environment, binary hashes, separate incremental-directory sizing, and external raw-evidence hashes.
Document correctness, warm runnable smoke, debugger/runtime limitations, cold setup budget, storage, concurrency, and publish fidelity as separate contracts.
acceptanceCriteria: Warm private and high-fanout changed-core build-through-version completes within 600 seconds.
Exact changed artifacts pass authenticated and benign shell-tool smokes.
Post-reconcile no-op rebuilds zero packages and completes within 30 seconds.
Cold target build-through-version is reported separately against a 720-second setup budget and never marketed as the warm SLO.
Unsafe concurrency, stale/interrupted provenance, and unowned cleanup fail closed.
Production release/publish configuration remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
Code and docs review converge with no Medium-or-higher findings.
